subject: AWS offering clarifications + co-sell enablement primer
messages:
From: Jordan Hale <jordan.hale@acme-robotics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-05T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing question

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the draft. A couple quick clarifying questions before we share with procurement:

- On the SKU/AMI side: do we need separate AMIs per region or can a single AMI be used for the US and EU launches?
- Pricing footnotes: we need a short line explaining throughput-based billing — can you add a one-liner?
- Co-sell collateral: our sales engineers want a 1-pager that explains how Redwood integrates into our deployment flow.

Also looping Erin from procurement who will need the compliance artifacts (SOC2, data residency notes).

Thanks,
Jordan
Senior Cloud Architect
Acme Robotics
[Signature: Jordan Hale | Acme Robotics | jordan.hale@acme-robotics.com | +1 415-555-0198]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Hale <jordan.hale@acme-robotics.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-05T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing question

Jordan — thanks for the quick read. Answers inline below and I attached a proposed offer copy and a co-sell checklist for your SEs.

- AMIs: single AMI is fine for US/EU if you accept global AMI sharing; however, for stricter data residency customers we recommend region-specific AMIs. I added a small note under "Deployment & Regions" to call this out.

- Pricing footnote: added: "Throughput-based billing reflects inference tokens processed; see per-model unit rates." We can tighten wording if you prefer an explicit example.

- 1-pager: attached as tab in the spreadsheet (tab: SE_onepager). It has architecture diagram, integration steps, and common FAQ.

Next steps: If this version looks good to you and Erin, we can push the AWS Offer for internal approval and then kick the co-sell enablement playbook (HubSpot playbook link included).

Attachments: aws_offer_draft_v3.md; co-sell_playbook_v2.xlsx

Best,
Kim
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: aws_offer_draft_v3.md (text/markdown)]
[Attachment: co-sell_playbook_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Hale <jordan.hale@acme-robotics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-05T12:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing question

Kim — quick suggestions from product for the offer copy (I edited the attached draft):

- Move the "Key benefits" bullets above the technical section — buyers see benefits first.
- Replace the phrase "throughput-based billing" with "inference tokens billed per 1,000 units" for clarity.
- Under "Supported architectures" call out compatibility with g4dn/g5 and CPU-only fallbacks.

I've highlighted the changes in aws_offer_draft_v3.md and added inline comments. Also added a short troubleshooting FAQ for SEs in the co-sell spreadsheet.

-Jonas
Senior Product Manager, Marketplace
[Attachment: aws_offer_draft_v3.md (REVISED, with product comments)]

From: Erin Lowe <erin.lowe@acme-robotics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Hale <jordan.hale@acme-robotics.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acme-robotics.com>
Date: 2027-12-06T08:21:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing question

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the materials. Procurement has two asks before we can approve the AWS PrivateOffer: 

1) Can you confirm SOC 2 Type II is maintained and provide the most recent report or an SSP summary?
2) We need export control and data residency language that will be visible on the product page (short paragraph + link to a longer compliance page).

If you can get those items to us by EOD Friday our internal review can be completed next week.

-Erin
Procurement Manager
Acme Robotics
[Procurement signature block]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Lowe <erin.lowe@acme-robotics.com>, Jordan Hale <jordan.hale@acme-robotics.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-12-07T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing question

Erin — appreciate the clear asks. Quick summary and commitments: 

- SOC 2 Type II: we will provide the redacted SOC 2 report and an SSP summary. I placed a link to the redacted bundle in Drive and attached a short compliance blurb for the product page.
- Data residency & export controls: short paragraph drafted below (feel free to reuse):

"Data residency: Redwood Inference processes inference requests in the region selected by the customer. For regulated deployments, we offer region-specific AMIs and VPC-only private deployments. Export controls: our product does not transmit customer data to 3rd parties; customers are responsible for content compliance. See full compliance pack: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-example"

Action items:
- I will upload the redacted SOC 2 to the Drive link and send the DocuSign template for the PrivateOffer by EOD tomorrow.
- Jonas will finalize the short pricing footnote and SE one-pager comments.
- Marissa — can you confirm legal is comfortable with the short compliance paragraph? If so, I'll proceed to request the AWS PrivateOffer.

Thanks all — pushing to get this over the line for next week's co-sell kickoff.

Best,
Kim
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
